notes: 13 Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment [was of] fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
21 That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through [the fire] for them?
38 And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
62 And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD:
